# East African Nature & Science Organization Journals

> Open-access academic publishing platform based in Nairobi, Kenya, hosting peer-reviewed journals across education, arts, social sciences, and Kiswahili studies.

EANSO Journals is a multi-disciplinary open-access publishing platform operated by the East African Nature and Science Organization. The platform provides manuscript submission, peer-review management, and dissemination of research across multiple journals serving East African scholars and the global academic community.

## Platform Overview

- [East African Nature & Science Organization Journals](https://journals.eanso.org): Homepage for EANSO open-access journals platform based in Nairobi
- [East African Nature & Science Organization Journals](https://journals.eanso.org/index.php/index): Main portal for EANSO academic journals and manuscript submissions
- [Start Here](https://journals.eanso.org/index.php/index/start): Getting started guide for EANSO journals platform and submissions
- [About Our Journals](https://journals.eanso.org/index.php/index/about-journals): Overview of EANSO journals, mission, and open-access publishing platform
- [Aim and Scope](https://journals.eanso.org/index.php/index/aim-scope): Editorial scope and research focus areas for EANSO journals

## Submission & Peer Review

- [Make a Submission](https://journals.eanso.org/index.php/index/make-a-submission): Manuscript submission guidelines and process for EANSO journals
- [Peer-Review Process](https://journals.eanso.org/index.php/index/peer-review-process): Documentation of EANSO peer-review and editorial workflow procedures
- [Reviewer's Guidelines](https://journals.eanso.org/index.php/index/reviewers): Guidelines for peer reviewers contributing to EANSO journals
- [Editorial Board](https://journals.eanso.org/index.php/index/editorial-board): EANSO editorial board members and journal governance structure

## Policies & Standards

- [Publication Ethics](https://journals.eanso.org/index.php/index/ethics): Publication ethics standards and research integrity policies for EANSO
- [Open Access Policy](https://journals.eanso.org/index.php/index/open-access): Creative Commons licensing and open-access policy for EANSO journals
- [Applicable Fees](https://journals.eanso.org/index.php/index/applicable-fee): Publication fees and cost information for EANSO journal submissions

## Active Journals

- [East African Journal of Education Studies](https://journals.eanso.org/index.php/eajes): Homepage for East African Journal of Education Studies journal
- [Vol 9 No 1 (2026): East African Journal of Education Studies](https://journals.eanso.org/index.php/eajes/issue/current): Current issue (Vol 9 No 1 2026) of Education Studies journal
- [East African Journal of Arts and Social Sciences](https://journals.eanso.org/index.php/eajass): Homepage for East African Journal of Arts and Social Sciences
- [Vol 9 No 1 (2026): East African Journal of Arts and Social Sciences](https://journals.eanso.org/index.php/eajass/issue/current): Current issue (Vol 9 No 1 2026) of Arts and Social Sciences journal
- [Jarida la Afrika Mashariki la Masomo ya Kiswahili](https://journals.eanso.org/index.php/eajss): East African Kiswahili Studies journal homepage in Swahili language
